Name: Dialogue to reflect town growing
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
Content Patcher required

You can choose when the dialogue starts. Default is on. Use Generic Mod Config Menu to change.  This allows you to see the original vanilla lines if you want. Before you complete a game achievement make sure the mod is turned on.  NPC's will now acknowledge changes you have made to Pelican Town, Ginger Island, Calico Desert, etc.
This mod changes dialogue of all NPC's except for the Dwarf,  Krobus and Leo. You have the option to turn off any NPCs dialogue changes. 

[b]To clarify you have the option of when the dialogue starts because I changed vanilla lines and everyone plays different. Maybe you have a game where you barely leave the farm the first year or so.  This gives you the opportunity to see the vanilla lines such as have you met my mom (Robin) or did you know Haley's my sister? Or maybe you're on a speed run and plan to complete the Community Center ASAP and don't want to see those lines again. 

Once the mod is enabled you do not have to do anything. As you get to know the NPC's and complete game achievements the dialogue will reflect that. 

This mod changes Vanilla lines and adds new lines related to game achievements. It does not change any married dialogue. If you are playing with another dialogue mod that changes Vanilla lines for a NPC, you can turn off the dialogue for that NPC. Meaning If you are using another dialogue mod that affects Maru (for example) you can exclude her changes while keeping the other NPC's changes.  [/b]

[b]If you have any questions, please ask. 
[/b]*****************

Completing JoJa Mart or Community Center route would bring in business.  Having the bus fixed means more people can visit. Having the bridge means adventures can explore more. Completing the Movie Theater brings entertainment.  Clint and Harvey would have increased business from adventures. Tourists would visit the Movie Theater, library & museum. They would shop at Pierre's and eat at the Saloon. 
The NPCs of Pelican Town will now reflect that you fixed up Ginger Island. There are also dialogue changes that show you have explored the valley and know the NPC's. Emily shouldn't ask you if you know Haley is her sister after being there for a while. Now she says Haley is a good sister.
I have also added dialogue. For example, we know that Abigail likes to explore so I added "You fixed up the new bridge and I got to explore the quarry. It was so much fun. Thank you." for after the bridge is repaired.
